summary: The audit checks 45 units of graduate coursework, at least 42 of them letter graded and each course with a C or better; 21 units of core and lab courses (at least three core courses and three labs, or, with the MS thesis option added to your plan, 9 units of MATSCI 200 in place of the labs; the thesis option takes 12 units of MATSCI 200 in all, and without it MATSCI 200 units count toward nothing, not even the 45); and four letter-graded 200-level MATSCI electives for 12 units. Checked by hand: the 12 units of technical electives in science, technology, engineering or math at the 200 level, the 3.0 GPA, the program proposal and completion forms, and taking at least one course each quarter that counts toward the degree.

program.why: Grading: "The minimum grade in each course applied towards degree requirements is a C."

totals.label: MATSCI 200 without the MS thesis option
totals.why: "Research units do not count unless the MS Thesis option is selected." and "If a master's thesis report is not submitted, units in MATSCI 200 Master's Research cannot be applied to the department's requirement of 45 units for the conferral of the master's degree."

4SNCmDzT.why: "Research participation and a thesis is not required for the degree, but there is the option for MS students to earn 12 units of credit in MATSCI 200 by researching with a lab professor over 3-4 quarters and writing a master's thesis report." The section is the MS thesis option, which a student adds to the plan.

vB75WFf4.why: "Students complete 21 units (7 courses) of core and laboratory coursework ... All courses must be taken for a letter grade." "at least 9 units (3 courses) must be core courses (MATSCI 211-215) and at least 9 units (3 courses) must be labs (MATSCI 170-176). The remaining 3 units (1 course) required may be an additional core or lab course" "Nine (9) research units of MATSCI 200 may be applied towards the laboratory requirements in this section only if the student is choosing to complete a MS thesis report". The stored rule asked for 7 of one child. The out-of-department lab allowed by petition is moved in by hand.

children.name: Laboratory courses, or the MS thesis option
MS thesis option: 9 units of MATSCI 200 in place of labs
Master's thesis report approved by two faculty readers
One more core or lab course

WsgfzskS.why: "Students complete 24 units of approved elective coursework to result in a technically cohesive program. Twelve units are 200+ level MATSCI elective courses; the additional twelve units are other approved electives"

IsHebWCn.why: "Four MATSCI Elective Courses are required (12 units). These must be 200+ Level MATSCI Courses taken for a letter grade (seminars, labs, and research units cannot apply)." Excluded: the research, colloquium, seminar, practical training, independent study and teaching courses the department names in its PhD section ("MATSCI 200, 230, 231, 232, 299, 300, 399, or 400") and the zero-unit TGR courses. The one out-of-department substitution by petition is moved in by hand. MATSCI 322 Transmission Electron Microscopy Laboratory is left out too: "labs ... cannot apply". MATSCI 402A and 402T (1-unit topics seminars offered only satisfactory/no credit) are left out too: the electives must be "taken for a letter grade (seminars ... cannot apply)".

ctRBQ064.why: "12 units of other Technical Electives are required. ... Technical electives must be letter-graded lecture/lab courses at the 200 level or above in science fields, technology, engineering, math, natural sciences, or statistics. ... Questions about the permissibility of particular courses ... should be directed to the Student Services Office for prior approval." The fields name no subject codes, so the student moves the courses in.

gz4Rnsvx.why: "there is the option for MS students to earn 12 units of credit in MATSCI 200 by researching with a lab professor over 3-4 quarters and writing a master's thesis report. These units are applied to the laboratory (9 units) and technical elective (3 units) requirements." The 12 units also count where the coursework rules use them (the thesis alternative to the labs, and the 3 units moved into technical electives), so the rule shares.
